sn45.178:1.1: Pañcime bhikkhave upādānakkhandhā || katame pañca || seyyathīdaṃ || || Rūpūpādanakkhando vedanūpādānakkhandho saññūpādānakkhando saṅkhārūpādānakkhandho {viññāṇūpādānakkhando} || ime kho bhikkhave pañcūpādānakkhandhā || || Imesaṃ kho bhikkhave pañcannam upādānakkhandhānam abhiññāya pariññāya parikkhayāya pahānāya || la || ayam ariyo aṭṭhaṅgiko maggo bhāvetabbo ti || || 2--33.
